title: Peasant Interior
alt: An elderly man, woman and boy sit around a low barrel partly covered with a white cloth, used as a makeshift table, in a plain room, while a girl stands by a fire in the background. Their clothes are torn. The boy holds a jug and a tall glass of red liquid; a pewter plate with food and a spoon rest on the barrel.

title: The Mourning Madonna
alt: Against a shining gold background, a woman in a royal-blue mantle covering her head and body stands with her head tipped sharply to rest in one hand. A dark violet cloth edged with gold hangs over her shoulders, and a halo is punched into the gold around her head.
